reviewed_surface: EndpointService and its local controller/client implementations; not a claim about deployed APIs or all external audit facilities.
findings: ListEndpoints returns current live entries only. Its Endpoint message does not expose the independently required attempt, lease, registration-time or deletion-reason fields.
The inspected EndpointService has no watch or replay RPC. EndpointDelta and ProxyMappingDelta are local callback types, not this service API; deletes carry endpoint IDs without deletion reasons.

RegisterEndpoint handles both registration and renewal. It creates a row with Timestamp.now() for registered_at on each successful upsert, so that stored timestamp must not be labeled original registration time without additional evidence.
UnregisterEndpoint is idempotent and returns Empty even when no row existed. A successful unregister response alone does not establish that this call removed a live registration.

EndpointClient.unregister untracks lease renewal before sending unregister; close uses best-effort cleanup and failures can leave expiry to the lease. Local shutdown completion and disappearance are distinct observations.
collection_decision: Do not implement a polling-only collector claiming full freshness/cleanup proof. It could record observed presence/absence but cannot supply missing lifecycle causes. Prepare separately authorized controller-side retained audit acquisition or leave those gates INCONCLUSIVE.
